#!/bin/bash
set -e

for STEP in 1800 2000 2200 2400 2600 2800 3000 3200 3400 3600 3800 4000 4200 4400 4600 4800 5000 5200 5400 5600 5800; do

    --model_name "${MODEL}" \
    --split val \
    --device cuda:0 \

done

echo "========== ALL SWEEP DONE =========="
